about.title: About Us
about.paragraph1: We are a leading company in the field of high-rise work in Israel, with over 15 years of experience in executing complex projects across the country. Our expertise is in rope access, building facade restoration, high-altitude sealing, stone cladding and anchoring, and bird control.
about.paragraph2: Our team consists of certified and experienced climbers with the highest level of professional training. We use the most advanced equipment and meet all required safety standards.
about.historyText: The company was founded in 2009 by our founder, a professional climber with extensive international high-rise work experience. The vision was to create a company that combines high professionalism, maximum safety, and personal service for every client. Today, we are proud to be one of the leading companies in the field in Israel.

services.subtitle: A wide range of professional high-rise work services with emphasis on safety, quality and reliable service

facadeRestoration.title: Facade Restoration & Renovation
facadeRestoration.description: Repair and renovation of building facades, crack treatment, replacement of damaged elements and facade structure restoration.

stoneVeneer.title: Stone Cladding & Anchoring
stoneVeneer.description: Installation of stone cladding at height, anchoring loose stones and treatment of natural and artificial stone facades.

waterproofing.title: High-Rise Waterproofing
waterproofing.description: Sealing roofs, exterior walls, balconies and windows. Prevention of water and moisture penetration into the building.

birdControl.title: Bird Control
birdControl.description: Installation of pigeon and bird deterrent systems, nets, spikes and electronic systems.

specialWorks.title: Special High-Rise Works
specialWorks.description: Unique projects requiring rope access, including special installations and art projects.

safetyInspections.title: Safety Inspections
safetyInspections.description: Periodic inspections of building facades, risk identification and detailed report writing.

anchoring.title: Anchor Drilling
anchoring.description: Professional drilling and anchoring for building reinforcement, railing installation and support systems.

generalRenovations.title: General Renovations
generalRenovations.description: Renovation and regular maintenance work for buildings, including painting, plastering and various repairs.
